name: (04) Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 2 Intermediate — Incinerate

system.description:
With a gesture and a glance the infernalist inscribes a circle of hellfire beneath an enemy, from which a column of flame erupts to the ceiling to consume them.

Issue a Mental Challenge that the target resists with their Physical Traits; on a win the ground beneath them erupts before they can dodge. The initial blast does two levels of aggravated damage to the victim and anyone in contact with them, and the primary target remains alight, taking one additional aggravated level every turn until they extinguish the blaze or perish. A victim may retest with Dodge. The flame is supernatural, ignoring mundane fire protection and armor; range is your line of sight. Retest with Occult.
